# PR #4324: Patch: the game log's card buttons meet the 24-pixel target on a mouse too

Closes #4296

## What changed

Each card-naming game-log line now exposes a hit target at least 24 pixels tall on fine pointers (mouse), while the log keeps its dense inline look and touch screens keep their 44-pixel rows. The accessibility statement no longer lists the sub-24-pixel mouse spacing as a known gap. Presentation only — no engine, server, or spec changes.

- [inspectable.css](apps/web/src/game/inspectable.css): new `@media (pointer: fine)` block giving `.log .log-card` `display: inline-block` (so `min-height` takes effect on the otherwise `inline` button) and `min-height: 24px`, placed between the base rule and the untouched coarse-pointer 44px block, with a WCAG 2.5.8 comment.
- [Log.test.tsx](apps/web/src/game/Log.test.tsx): new `describe("the log's card-name target size")` with two stylesheet-text tests — the fine-pointer 24px rule plus retained `display: inline` base, and the verbatim coarse-pointer 44px block — using `readSheet` from `src/test/setup.ts`.
- [accessibility.tsx](apps/web/src/routes/accessibility.tsx), [static-pages.ts](apps/web/static-pages.ts), [zh-CN.json](apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json): the "With a mouse, the card names in the game log…" known-gap bullet removed from all three copies. `board.css`, `Log.tsx`, and `spec/` untouched per the plan.

## How I tested it

- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/Log.test.tsx` — 52/52 pass, including the 2 new tests (re-confirmed via `-t "target"`: 4 matched, 4 passed, 0 failed).
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/static-pages.test.ts` — 24/24 pass, including the word-for-word accessibility quote test proving route and `PAGE_TEXT` match.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/i18n/i18n.test.ts` — 7/7 pass with `--testTimeout=120000`.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` — exit 0. `pnpm exec eslint` on the three touched web files — exit 0. `cargo fmt --check` — exit 0.

- No decisions beyond the plan: I followed it exactly and departed nowhere, so there is no rejected alternative to record.
